name: qwen3_8b_fixes_doc_smoke_candidate
description: Candidate multiple-choice questions for docs/qwen3-8b-fixes.md. Must be baseline-gated before compact policy interpretation.

tasks.question: What was the main goal of the Qwen3-8B validation section?

choices.A: Validate W4A8C4 quality at a 7B-scale model and check tensor-parallel memory behavior
choices.B: Train a new tokenizer from scratch
choices.C: Replace all attention with CPU disk IO

tasks.question: Which model was chosen because Qwen3 had no 7B model on modelscope?
What output symptom showed W4A8 and W4A8C4 collapsed on Qwen3-8B?

choices.A: They generated repeated backslashes or garbage text
choices.C: They refused to allocate tokenizer merges

tasks.question: What did the Qwen3-8B results imply about the C4-only path?

choices.B: C4-only was roughly online while W4A8 was the main problem

tasks.question: What was corrected about tensor parallel memory measurement?

choices.A: Peak memory alone was misleading because KV cache filled freed space
choices.C: The tokenizer consumed all GPU memory
choices.D: The model had no KV cache

tasks.question: Which metric was added to observe whether TP split model weights?
After separating weight and KV cache memory, what did the document conclude about TP?

choices.A: TP weight splitting was working correctly

tasks.question: What is the corrected interpretation of gpu_memory_utilization?

choices.A: It means each GPU may fill memory up to that utilization with weights and KV cache
choices.B: It must be divided by TP size automatically
choices.D: It disables KV cache on TP runs

tasks.question: Which issue was suspected in the W4A8 numerical collapse?

choices.A: Activation outlier channels and coarse W4 group scaling

tasks.question: What activation fake-quantization fix was introduced?

choices.A: Soft outlier clipping using a p999-based clip value

tasks.question: Which W4 group size was needed for the 8B lightweight fix?
How did the document frame a full SmoothQuant approach at that point?

choices.A: As a more complete future direction rather than the lightweight fix
choices.B: As already replacing all model weights
